name: exchange-online-mcp
description: Exchange Online admin for MSPs over REST: forwarding audits, EWS posture, offboarding and quarantine across client tenants, no PowerShell session.

exchange_online_token.title: Exchange Online access token
exchange_online_token.description: Sets EXCHANGE_ONLINE_TOKEN for the Exchange Online Admin MCP server. Get a credential from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/reference/admin-api-authentication.

exchange_online_base_url.title: Exchange Online API base URL
exchange_online_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank to use https://outlook.office365.com. Set it only for a national cloud or a test server; the token then goes to that host.

exchange_online_anchor_mailbox.title: Routing mailbox
exchange_online_anchor_mailbox.description: Optional. The X-AnchorMailbox value for calls with no target mailbox, for example UPN:admin@example.com with a delegated token. Leave blank to use the organization system mailbox Microsoft documents for app-only calls.

exchange_online_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
exchange_online_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to keep only read tools: exchange-online_read still serves the Get-* cmdlets, and every write tool is removed.

exchange_online_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
exchange_online_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop saving reads locally; reads go to the API. An inbox-rule sweep or quarantine snapshot you run is still saved.

exchange_online_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
exchange_online_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

exchange_online_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
exchange_online_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Exchange requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank; each call names its tenant ID.
